title: Deciding a language within a space bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be a space bound. The machine decides $L$ within space $s$ if, for every input $x$, there is a time bound $T$ such that every choice sequence of length $T$ uses at most $s(|x|)$ space, the machine halts within $T$ steps, and $x\in L$ exactly when the machine accepts within $T$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean strings
A language L of Boolean strings
